summary: The current-contract mapping run completed 65 models with zero failures and reproduced the canonical cells and coefficients before running rule-based service exclusions, inherited outcome-informed deletion refits, and occupation influence diagnostics. Fast food and counter workers supply 19.51 percent of squared local influence; the effective contributing-occupation count is 14.54. Exact inherited deletion estimates are reported as post-outcome diagnostics, not confirmatory tests. Public reconstruction passed at machine precision, but W01 remains RUN_UNVALIDATED pending closure of upstream T02 and integrated manuscript presentation.
